name: DiaSorin S.p.A.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le nombre d'analyseurs installés est le principal driver de croissance récurrente via la vente de kits consommables, un modèle économique récurrent typique des leaders en diagnostics in vitro.

kpis.explanation: Nombre total d'analyseurs LIAISON placés chez les clients, base pour vendre des tests récurrents.
kpis.signal: Installed base exceeding 7,800 units as of end-2018, with LIAISON XL representing more than 50% of analyzers: foundation for recurring revenue.
kpis.description: The installed base is the cornerstone of DiaSorin's recurring revenue model, as each analyzer drives repeated sales of diagnostic kits.

kpis.explanation: Chiffre d'affaires consolidé du groupe DiaSorin.
kpis.signal: 2018 confirmed excellent financial results with increased revenues and profitability.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue demonstrating sustained growth through portfolio expansion and continued analyzer deployment across immunodiagnostics and molecular diagnostics.

kpis.explanation: Portefeuille de tests hautement spécialisés en immunodiagnostic.
kpis.signal: Over 115 products including 30 high-specialty tests: broadest specialty menu available on the global immunodiagnostic market.
kpis.description: DiaSorin maintains the broadest portfolio in specialized immunodiagnostics with 30 high-specialty tests, positioning the company as the immunodiagnostic specialist globally.

kpis.name_fr: Nouveaux kits de diagnostic moléculaire lancés
kpis.explanation: Nombre de nouveaux kits de diagnostic moléculaire mis sur le marché durant la période.
kpis.signal: 4 new molecular diagnostic kits launched in 2018, including latent tuberculosis test following QIAGEN QuantiFERON agreement.
kpis.description: Extension of the portfolio in molecular diagnostics segment with strategic growth prospects, including the latent tuberculosis test developed through QIAGEN collaboration offering strong market potential globally.

kpis.name_fr: Nouveaux réactifs spécifiques à l'analyte lancés
kpis.explanation: Réactifs spécifiques à l'analyte lancés pour plateformes moléculaires LIAISON MDX.
kpis.signal: 11 new ASRs launched in 2018, strengthening the menu available on LIAISON MDX platform.
kpis.description: New Analyte Specific Reagents enable laboratories to customize their diagnostic tests, reinforcing platform adhesion and expanding the diagnostic menu on LIAISON MDX.

kpis.explanation: Dépenses en recherche et développement en pourcentage du revenu.
kpis.signal: R&D at 13% of revenue: strong commitment to innovation and development of new platforms.
kpis.description: Sustained investment in research and development to expand test menus and develop innovative platforms such as LIAISON XS for small-medium sized laboratories.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or connected technologies in the 2018 annual report. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever in this period.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or advanced algorithms in the shareholder letter or business review
Focus on biological testing, immunodiagnostics, and molecular diagnostic kit development
No mention of advanced digitalization or predictive analytics tools
ai_positioning.source: 2018 Annual Financial Report, Letter to Shareholders
